Alvora Diamonds

Alvora Diamonds is a laboratory-grown diamond business based in Surat, India. It sells finished fine jewellery set with laboratory-grown diamonds (engagement rings, earrings and pendants in 14K and 18K gold) to private customers through an enquiry-first process, and supplies wholesale laboratory-grown diamonds for jewellery retailers, manufacturers, designers, and other trade buyers, including loose stones, calibrated layouts, matched pairs, melee, fancy shapes and colours, and custom-cut requirements. The available company-specific source material does not establish a public capacity figure, team size, or universal service level.
